svg.text: B. The hill: the street climbs, the block is built into the slope
Larch Street rises 12 m from Walt's shop (west, at the creek) to the hill house (east). Height does the work: terraces above the street, houses below it, the creek bed under it.
THE TOP PATH (+9 above the street, behind a 2.7 wall): sees the whole street, the stalking height
LARCH STREET climbing 10 %: +0 at Walt's, +12 at the gate
THE CREEK BED (3 m below the street; dry and stony in summer): the low route
grid 10 m; heights in metres above the street
Roof route (gold: fast, unseen on back pitches)
Under route (creek bed, culvert, crawl spaces)
Fence or wall 1.8 m: mantle from the ground
Hedge 1.2 m: hides a crouched Nadia
Switch: open or shut per night
Three heights instead of three bands:
the creek bed (-3, hidden), the street (0,
watched), the terraces and Top Path
Boulevard: the creek runs under the
Costs: sloped terrain to author; the
whole street is visible from above,
so stealth on the street is hard.
Section through houses 3 and 2 (x = 40): Top Path to creek bed, looking east
heights drawn 2.6x taller than lengths so they read; numbers are true metres
